subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should this PR require redacted live Gateway/provider outage proof before merge, or may deterministic MemoryIndexManager regression coverage be accepted as an explicit proof override for this recovery fix?
rationale: The code path looks correct from source review, but OpenClaw’s external-PR proof gate normally requires real after-fix behavior evidence and the contributor explicitly lacks a live Gateway/Ollama outage harness.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs, copied live output, or a recording showing memory_search falling back during a provider outage, the primary recovering, and a later search returning results.

options.title: Accept deterministic proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the real-manager mock-provider regression coverage as sufficient because it exercises the same manager recovery path but does not prove live provider behavior.

options.title: Pause for maintainer-run proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until someone with Gateway plus provider infrastructure captures the real recovery transcript or builds a small reusable live harness.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs, copied live output, or a recording showing memory_search falling back during a provider outage, the primary recovering, and a later search returning results.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent and historical memory provider-state refactor work in the files that own this recovery behavior.
